newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC to build GSM base stations for Swedish railway.
newsitem.headline: NCC to build GSM base stations for Swedish railway.

text.p: Swedish construction group NCC said on Wednesday it would build GSM radio base stations for the Swedish railway authority, which will invest 830 million crowns in the total communication project.
NCC did not disclose the value of its portion of the order.
The first phase, Stockholm-Gothenburg, has already been decided upon and that investment totals 250 million crowns, NCC said in a statement.
"Decisions about another three phases are expected later," it said.
The base stations will be used for all radio communications along the railway, for example text, speech and data transfer, NCC said.
